title: A Perturbation-Driven Framework for Sensitivity Analysis of Dimensionality Reduction
abstract: arXiv:2611.33523v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-dimensional representations produced by dimensionality reduction (DR) are commonly evaluated using distortion measures such as trustworthiness and continuity. In this paper, we study the sensitivity of DR methods to plausible input variations by quantifying changes in structural preservation and visually diagnosing how these changes manifest in the resulting representations. This perspective reflects the fact that real-world datasets are finite, noisy samples of an underlying distribution, and DR should not produce substantially different structures under small data changes. We introduce a model-agnostic, perturbation-driven sensitivity evaluation framework that treats perturbations as controlled probes of plausible data variation. Across multiple perturbation families and strength levels, we repeatedly perturb the input, apply a DR method, and evaluate the resulting low-dimensional representations using a set of distortion measures

translated_title: 一种用于降维敏感性分析的扰动驱动框架
translated_abstract: 由降维（DR）产生的低维表示通常使用可信度和连续性等失真度量进行评估。在本文中，我们通过量化结构保持方面的变化并视觉诊断这些变化如何在最终表示中体现，来研究降维方法对合理输入变化的敏感性。这一视角反映了现实世界数据集是底层分布的有限、含噪样本这一事实，即降维不应在数据发生微小变化时产生显著不同的结构。我们引入了一个模型无关的、扰动驱动的敏感性评估框架，该框架将扰动视为对合理数据变化的受控探针。在多种扰动族和强度水平下，我们反复扰动输入，应用降维方法，并使用一组失真度量来评估所得的低维表示。
tldr: 本文提出一种模型无关的扰动驱动敏感性评估框架，将扰动视为对合理数据变化的受控探针，通过量化结构保持的变化与视觉诊断来评估降维方法对输入微小变化的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a model-agnostic, perturbation-driven framework that treats perturbations as controlled probes of plausible data variation, evaluating the sensitivity of dimensionality reduction methods by quantifying changes in structural preservation and visually diagnosing how these changes manifest in the resulting representations.
